COMPUTATION OF DERIVED 
ANTHROPOMETRIC PARAMETERS

area (AMA) are based on measurements of AC of TSF. Equa-
tions for estimating AMA corrected for bone area are pre-
sented because they provide more accurate assessments of 
bone-free muscle area. Th e computational steps are outlined
